quest.title: Journey of Stars and Flames
quest.description: The final battle with the Abyss is at hand. You have the support of all in Natlan, and they will do so in various ways. Once you are ready, journey forth to the last battleground.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x1425, Mora x62225, Hero's Wit x6, Mystic Enhancement Ore x11

talks.objective: Go to the Stadium of the Sacred Flame

dialogues.speaker: Vichama
dialogues.text: That was amazing... Judging by your clothes, you're not from Natlan, are you?

dialogues.speaker: Mallko
dialogues.text: I've never seen a soul like you in the Night Kingdom.

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: But, the Night Kingdom doesn't accept outlanders... right?

dialogues.speaker: "Cocouik"
dialogues.text: Croo...

response.speaker: Guthred
response.text: Yes... Although, rather than a soul, it would be more accurate to say that I'm a "story" created by the people of Natlan.

response.speaker: Guthred
response.text: I was his most trusted second-in-command. Five hundred years ago, we fought against the Abyss together, and I sacrificed myself during battle.

response.speaker: Guthred
response.text: The shamans of the Masters of the Night-Wind recorded my story on a woven scroll. Even now, many in Natlan know my name.

response.speaker: Vichama
response.text: So, you're him, but also not him?

response.speaker: Guthred
response.text: That's right. What you see is the "me" from the story. I was remembered as a glorious hero, even though the truth is quite the opposite.

response.speaker: Guthred
response.text: It was in fragmented memories of my life that I finally began to understand the real "me."

response.speaker: Guthred
response.text: Unlike my righteous and noble commander, I was obsessive and cruel, an approach I believed to be more efficient. Our differences caused many an argument between us.

choices.text: No wonder you were ready to...

response.speaker: Mallko
response.text: Y—You tried to... sacrifice someone?

response.speaker: Guthred
response.text: ..."I" will stop at nothing to protect my commander's interests.

response.speaker: Guthred
response.text: The most idealistic and righteous among us are the most fragile, so I must protect his edge. A strong hand is required to stand against a strong foe.

response.speaker: Guthred
response.text: That is what "the glory of Khaenri'ah" means to me.

choices.text: So, you still believe in him?

response.speaker: Guthred
response.text: I do.

response.speaker: Guthred
response.text: I have my reasons, as do all who believe in something. You will understand that soon enough.

response.speaker: Guthred
response.text: Due to the limitations of the Ley Lines, we can go no further. The enemy's lair is close at hand.

response.speaker: Vichama
response.text: But don't worry — all the souls of the Night Kingdom will lend you their aid.

response.speaker: Mallko
response.text: You will become the hero of a new era.

response.speaker: Bona
response.text: You're a special one, Traveler! You've proved that again just now!

response.speaker: Och-Kan
response.text: (The light will continue to guide your way through the endless darkness.)

response.speaker: Guthred
response.text: Go now. For Natlan — and for all who lost their lives to the Abyss.

response.speaker: Guthred
response.text: This time, we shall prevail, not for any single nation or faction, but for us all.

choices.text: Even though he's a stranger to you now.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, you're here.

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: Judging by the confident look on your face, I assume your ancient name is complete?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yep, it's good to go! Xilonen specifically reminded us to show it to you!

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: "Tum{RUBY#[D]Hope}aini"... Yes, that fits you perfectly.

response.speaker: Atoco
response.text: Is that... an ancient name?

response.speaker: Rayen
response.text: I heard this is the first time we've forged an ancient name for an outlander. Seems like it was a success... What's engraved on it?

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: #Looks like my people are just as curious about this name. {NICKNAME}, Paimon, join me over here.

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: #As you can see, I am holding {NICKNAME}'s ancient name.

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: #With this name, the Wayob entrust to {M#him}{F#her} a monumental task, and this land binds us as kin.

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: #"Tum{RUBY#[D]Hope}aini"... That is {M#his}{F#her} name. Like starlight amid the darkness, flames amid the cold — it means "hope."

response.speaker: Sakowew
response.text: "Tum{RUBY#[D]Hope}aini"...!

response.speaker: Tantoo
response.text: Hope... After all these endless years of fighting, we've finally found it, haven't we...

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: Ever since the invasion of the Abyss and the decline of the Ley Lines, the Ode of Resurrection has protected us for thousands of years.

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: For generations we have lived on this land, following in the footsteps of our forebears, taking their place on the frontlines.

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: We all carry that struggle with us. And now, thanks to your efforts, the end is in sight — we have a chance to defeat the Abyss once and for all.

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: This glory is one we share — it belongs to all of Natlan.

response.speaker: Otaska
response.text: For Natlan!

response.speaker: Everyone Together
response.text: For Natlan!

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: Our suffering will not soon be forgotten, but there will come a day when we can proudly declare to our progeny that this war is won!

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: For our fallen heroes, our lifelong comrades, and all who forged the path ahead through trial and tribulation. For our homeland...

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: We will claim victory! In Natlan, no one fights alone!

response.speaker: Everyone Together
response.text: No one fights alone!

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: To battle!

dialogues.speaker: Wayna
dialogues.text: On behalf of the Scions of the Canopy, I offer you our blessing.

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: The name of "Turnfire" teaches us that everything comes at a price. We've offered generations of blood and tears to this war, and now, it's time to collect.

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: We're all counting on you to take revenge, including the Mountain King.

dialogues.speaker: Kongamato
dialogues.text: During the Turnfire Night, I once said... "May the will of Kongamato... march ever on, until the Abyss is stamped out."

dialogues.speaker: Kongamato
dialogues.text: Recently, I saw him again in my dreams... my most trusted partner, Burkina.

dialogues.speaker: Kongamato
dialogues.text: He believed this would be the battle to end all battles and implored me to lend my support to the hero of this era.

dialogues.speaker: Kongamato
dialogues.text: As expected, traveler from afar, that hero is you.

dialogues.speaker: Kongamato
dialogues.text: From the first time we met, I sensed something special. You remind me of someone... the one who moved Burkina to their side...

dialogues.speaker: Kongamato
dialogues.text: I firmly believe you will defeat the forces of darkness. That miracle belongs to this era.

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: We will answer to the fire for all our deeds, and so shall the Abyss answer for its crimes.

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: Oh, and Ajaw has something to say.

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: Although you are but lowly servants, you have brought us much amusement.

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: We desire that entertainment to continue. If this is where you meet your end, it would be a great disappointment.

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: We would get over it, of course. But, if you do die, just go without regrets.

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: That's the nicest send-off you're going to get out of Ajaw.

dialogues.speaker: Amina
dialogues.text: In this place where streams and waves converge, the People of the Springs gather to honor your bravery.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Uncle Nuu's here to see you off, too!

dialogues.speaker: Nuu
dialogues.text: You, young hero, are about to make history. Heh, my deeds are nothing compared to that.

dialogues.speaker: Nuu
dialogues.text: When our ancestors first set out on their adventure, they could never have known they were about to found a tribe that would last thousands of years into the future.

dialogues.speaker: Nuu
dialogues.text: When future generations look back on our accomplishment, they, too, will see our deeds for their greater significance.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: #Hey, why don't we record {NICKNAME}'s story on a stone tablet, just like the one on the mysterious island!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Haha, great! I better get on it, or someone might beat me to it!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Everyone in my tribe wants you to become one of Natlan's greatest heroes. Me too, obviously...

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: But, as your friend, there's something I want even more, and it's way simpler...

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Once this is all over, I wanna go to the hotsprings together. Paimon included!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: That's what being friends is all about — quality time and good vibes!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It's a promise!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: I'll hold you to it!

choices.text: Make sure you put it somewhere people can see it.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Of course! Front and center — just like the first chief!

dialogues.speaker: Mutota
dialogues.text: May the skies forever be clear and bright, and may we always be free to spread our wings and soar. For this wish, the Flower-Feather Clan gathers here today.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: War is a heavy burden. And still, we never stopped moving forward.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Long-awaited peace is now within reach. You have the opportunity to set that future in motion.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: I'll be rooting for you... Oh, and Coya heard about the battle, so she's here, too.

dialogues.speaker: Coya
dialogues.text: Cheep...

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: We both had to make a difficult choice about family. But, after our adventure together, we finally let go of our differences, and she came to understand my attachment to human society.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Within the tribe, I found new sources of love and happiness. Coya told me she would do anything to protect that.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: And I would do the same for her.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: The same goes for my human family... Chuychu's father and mother.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Maybe my relationships seem like a mess to you... But, it's okay. I won't let any one of them fall by the wayside.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: I will learn from everything we've been through and rise above the trials of fate to become a better version of myself.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's like you're becoming your own "peacemaker."

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Thank you, but beyond that...

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: I pledge to be someone you can lean on in all your future endeavors.

dialogues.speaker: Pacal
dialogues.text: You're about to set off, right?

dialogues.speaker: Pacal
dialogues.text: Your bravery is like an echo through the valley, calling on us to respond in kind. The Children of Echoes offer you our blessing.

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Everyone is waiting for you back at the Stadium! We'll be cheering the whole time!

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: The Abyss is powerful, but there's no reason to fear. We've defeated it before, and you can do it again.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Go now and forge a new future for Natlan.

dialogues.speaker: Wayna
dialogues.text: On behalf of the Scions of the Canopy, I offer you our blessing.

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: The name of "Turnfire" teaches us that everything comes at a price. We've offered generations of blood and tears to this war, and now, it's time to collect.

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: The Abyss must pay for what it has done.

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: Oh, and Ajaw has something to say.

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: Although you are but lowly servants, you have brought us much amusement.

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: We desire that entertainment to continue. If this is where you meet your end, it would be a great disappointment.

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: We would get over it, of course. But, if you do die, just go without regrets.

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: That's the nicest send-off you're going to get out of Ajaw.

dialogues.speaker: Amina
dialogues.text: In this place where streams and waves converge, the People of the Springs gather to honor your bravery.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: I love the hot springs! I can't get enough of them.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: I wanna go today, and tomorrow, and the day after that.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Just thinking about spending time there with you and all our friends makes me so happy!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: So, after the battle, let's go there together! Paimon included! Sound good?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sounds good!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: YES! I'm so excited!

dialogues.speaker: Mutota
dialogues.text: May the skies forever be clear and bright, and may we always be free to spread our wings and soar. For this wish, the Flower-Feather Clan gathers here today.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: War is a heavy burden. And still, we never stopped moving forward.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Long-awaited peace is now within reach. You have the opportunity to set that future in motion.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: It's taken a lot to get to this point. I know it will not be in vain.

dialogues.speaker: Biram
dialogues.text: A revelation came to me in a dream, and I shared it with my tribe — you are the star that will shine through the mist.

dialogues.speaker: Biram
dialogues.text: The spirits bless your journey.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: From this day forward, plants will sprout because of you, insects will take flight after you, and all will turn to your will.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That seems like overkill...

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: I disagree. The land of Natlan nurtures life, but the Abyss knows only destruction.

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: Natlan is also a land of memories and legends.

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: I live longer than humans, and in all that time, I've learned what life and death mean to people.

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: The dead draw solace from the living, and the living push forward in honor of the dead.

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: In life and death, we all leave marks on this world. We cannot let them be reduced to nothing.

response.speaker: Citlali
response.text: Yes... Thank you for joining this fight.

response.speaker: Citlali
response.text: I'll wait for your safe return.

dialogues.speaker: Acatl
dialogues.text: At the end of the earth lies the primal flame. We have come from afar to offer you our land's blessing and the respect of the Collective of Plenty.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: True strength isn't gifted from the heavens. It culminates little by little from everything we do.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Natlan's history goes back thousands of years. Every person who calls this land home — past or present — has a hand in this opportunity.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Just like the Pyro Archon's concept of time — the past, the present, and the future exist at once. This moment is a convergence of all three.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: I have full confidence in the outcome of this battle. Victory will belong to Natlan.

response.speaker: Iansan
response.text: Actually, I also have a more... personal request.

response.speaker: Iansan
response.text: Once the war is over, come visit us in the Collective of Plenty, okay?

response.speaker: Acatl
response.text: Haha, that's right! Our tribe can't wait to meet you.

response.speaker: Iansan
response.text: Varesa and I will show you all our customs and fun activities.

response.speaker: Iansan
response.text: I'll leave you in suspense for now. But I promise you won't be disappointed!

choices.text: Your hard work will not be in vain.

dialogues.speaker: Pacal
dialogues.text: You're about to set off, right?

dialogues.speaker: Pacal
dialogues.text: Your bravery is like an echo through the valley, calling on us to respond in kind. The Children of Echoes offer you our blessing.

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Everyone is waiting for you back at the Stadium! We'll be cheering the whole time!

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: The Abyss is powerful, but there's no reason to fear. We've defeated it before, and you can do it again.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Oh, and I brought Nepecha with me. She really wanted to see you.

dialogues.speaker: Nepecha
dialogues.text: #Hello, {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} {NICKNAME} ...

dialogues.speaker: Nepecha
dialogues.text: Not too long ago, you and Xilonen saved me, and helped me recover my real name.

dialogues.speaker: Nepecha
dialogues.text: And now, you're going somewhere super dangerous in the name of everyone in Natlan...

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: #Yeah, {F#s}he's amazing!

dialogues.speaker: Nepecha
dialogues.text: Xilonen says a name is like a blessing, so I wanna give you my blessing, too.

dialogues.speaker: Nepecha
dialogues.text: But, um, I don't know any fancy words, so... Just be safe, and come visit us soon!

dialogues.speaker: Nepecha
dialogues.text: We can celebrate your birthday next time!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sounds good to me!

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Hehe, then it's a promise!

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: That's right — a promise to meet again in the future.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Our tribe is always open to you. Whenever you choose to return, we'll welcome you back with a huge feast of barbecue and wine.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: I have no doubt that victory will be ours.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: We're here. I'm sure you're familiar with the sight of the Night Kingdom by now.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: The corrosion here is relatively mild, so this is our last pit stop.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Once we set off, we must destroy our final enemy as soon as possible. Otherwise, no amount of resistance to Abyssal corrosion will save us from contamination.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, there's no turning back after this, huh...

choices.text: Paimon? What are you doing here?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: After you left, Paimon started to be able to see this place. It's a mystery to Paimon, too...

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Roar!

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: The Sacred Flame is connecting us. The moment it sent us here, it made sure your consciousness could reach us.

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: Still, you can go no further. The Abyss also has the power to corrupt the mind, so once we venture deeper, it must be alone.

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: But, while we're still here, I believe some of your friends may wish to say a few words.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: We don't have much time, right?

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: True, but there's time enough to say goodbye.

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: Come find me when you're ready to set off. I'll explain the next step of the plan.

talks.objective: Talk to Mavuika once you're ready

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: #Are you ready, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: Alright. Before we face our final enemy together, we need to split up.

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: I'm sure you remember the "Abyss Tumors" from the previous battle. Eradicating them was crucial to stopping the endless onslaught of monsters.

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: Our final enemy has a core that possesses similar qualities. It's hidden somewhere in the Night Kingdom.

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: Since I'm more familiar with this place, I will go find and destroy this core while you go straight to the enemy's lair. We can reconvene there.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Understood.

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: Alright, then it's time to act.

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: All of Natlan is behind us. So let's gather our courage and march into the unknown without fear.

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: No one fights alone.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Mavuika already left, so you should get moving. Oh, um, and Paimon should stop distracting you...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon still remembers her promise! She's gonna cheer you on with all her might!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's not some kid who's afraid of the dark. She's gonna be brave this time, so don't you worry!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Wait for me, Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Always!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Roar!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're not in this alone — we'll be with you in spirit the whole time!

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: That's fine. It's best to move forward without regrets.

dialogues.speaker: Atea
dialogues.text: I didn't expect to see you again so soon.

dialogues.speaker: Nechca
dialogues.text: Phew, I didn't know I could do that!

dialogues.speaker: Nechca
dialogues.text: #Hello, {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wait, you're...?

dialogues.speaker: Nechca
dialogues.text: You remember Tlazolli, right? She's my mom, and well... She did a lot of bad things.

dialogues.speaker: Nechca
dialogues.text: I saw her in a dream, and she spent the whole time apologizing to me. But, I didn't know what to say...

dialogues.speaker: Nechca
dialogues.text: Nepecha, all those people who lost their memories... They're the ones who deserve apologies, not me.

dialogues.speaker: Atea
dialogues.text: Nechca told me all about what happened, and this was my advice...

dialogues.speaker: Atea
dialogues.text: Even though we can't undo our mistakes, there will always be opportunities to make up for them.

dialogues.speaker: Nechca
dialogues.text: I had a good talk with my mom in that dream, and she agreed to lend me her power. That's how I was able to help you back there.

dialogues.speaker: Nechca
dialogues.text: My mom made a lot of terrible mistakes in the past. But, now... she's using her powers for good.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It was a huge help.

dialogues.speaker: Atea
dialogues.text: You're a very talented person, Nechca. I'm sorry your life was cut so short.

dialogues.speaker: Nechca
dialogues.text: It's okay. We still managed to do something important in this place!

dialogues.speaker: Nechca
dialogues.text: #Good luck, {NICKNAME}! We're all counting on you!

dialogues.speaker: Atea
dialogues.text: You can leave this place to us. When the monsters attack again, we'll fend them off.

choices.text: Mualani's in the square over there.

response.speaker: Atea
response.text: We got to see each other in a dream, and that's enough.

response.speaker: Atea
response.text: The square makes it possible to connect the living to the Night Kingdom. If the Abyss starts to corrode that area, its forces could once again surge into the land above.

response.speaker: Atea
response.text: It pains me, not being able to see Mualani again. But, if I can do something to protect Natlan, then that is the only choice.

response.speaker: Atea
response.text: Mualani will grow to surpass me as a warrior and accomplish greater feats than my own — I have no doubt.

choices.text: I'm sure she'd like to see you again.

talks.objective: Defeat opponents and explore up ahead

dialogues.speaker: Hine
dialogues.text: Hey, Sis! It's been a long time... This form is probably what I look like in your memories, right?

dialogues.speaker: Hine
dialogues.text: Actually, we already met in one of your dreams, didn't we? But... You never told anyone.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Out of all the awakened souls, I was surprised "you" were one of them. After all, it's been five hundred years.

dialogues.speaker: Hine
dialogues.text: Hehe, yeah. I'm sure my soul has been reborn many times by now. But, that doesn't mean "Hine" is gone.

dialogues.speaker: Hine
dialogues.text: If the past, present, and future exist at once, then it's only fair we get to meet again.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: You're right.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: It's too bad we don't have more time to talk.

dialogues.speaker: Hine
dialogues.text: Your plan is almost at the final stage, isn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Hine
dialogues.text: I knew it. When you set your mind to something, there's nothing you can't do, no matter how difficult.

dialogues.speaker: Hine
dialogues.text: I really wanted to help you in this era, but an ordinary person can't transcend time.

dialogues.speaker: Hine
dialogues.text: Back then, I said I'd come find you one day. But, I failed time and time again.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: You didn't fail.

dialogues.speaker: Hine
dialogues.text: Wait, then, the paper frog I made... You got it?

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Yes, and your architecture manual, as well. The family you left it with got it to me in one piece.

dialogues.speaker: Hine
dialogues.text: Haha, I'm so glad! Five hundred years is a long time... I was worried someone might toss it during a move or something.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: No, they never forgot their debt to you. I learned a lot about you from them.

dialogues.speaker: Hine
dialogues.text: Sounds like I placed my trust in the right people.

dialogues.speaker: Hine
dialogues.text: Everything I wrote, though... It's probably outdated now, isn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Yeah, I'd say so.

dialogues.speaker: Hine
dialogues.text: Oh, well! It's been a long time, and it's not like I was some innovative architect who left my mark on history.

dialogues.speaker: Hine
dialogues.text: But, I lived a really happy life. I dedicated my career to helping those without a home...

dialogues.speaker: Hine
dialogues.text: I didn't have time for love, or for myself, but I didn't care. There are so many things in this world that deserve to come first — that's what you taught me.

dialogues.speaker: Hine
dialogues.text: You never took time for yourself either, did you, Sis?

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: No, it wasn't necessary. Besides, I made my choice... And now, the end is near — be it the enemy's end, or my own.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: In the end, the method you used to transcend time was much more than a simple paper frog.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: You sent your love across time. So, let me say this, Hine — I will love you forever and always.

dialogues.speaker: Hine
dialogues.text: Hehe, I know that! Mom, Dad, and I... We feel the same way about you. We're family — that will never change!

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Alright, I need to head out. Another hero is waiting for me.

dialogues.speaker: Hine
dialogues.text: I believe in you, Sis!

dialogues.speaker: Hine
dialogues.text: For Natlan!

dialogues.speaker: Atea
dialogues.text: I didn't expect to see you again so soon.

dialogues.speaker: Atea
dialogues.text: You can leave this place to us. When the monsters attack again, we'll fend them off.

choices.text: Mualani's in the square over there.

response.speaker: Atea
response.text: We got to see each other in a dream, and that's enough.

response.speaker: Atea
response.text: The square makes it possible to connect the living to the Night Kingdom. If the Abyss starts to corrode that area, its forces could once again surge into the land above.

response.speaker: Atea
response.text: It pains me, not being able to see Mualani again. But, if I can do something to protect Natlan, then that is the only choice.

response.speaker: Atea
response.text: Mualani will grow to surpass me as a warrior and accomplish greater feats than my own — I have no doubt.

choices.text: I'm sure she'd like to see you again.

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: Wow, you're as strong as ever.

dialogues.speaker: "Cocouik"
dialogues.text: Cheep!

dialogues.speaker: Vichama
dialogues.text: Oh, who are these two?

choices.text: An amazing adventurer and her companion.

response.speaker: Bona
response.text: Hehe, you said it, not me. Everyone here is amazing, so of course that includes me and Coco.

response.speaker: Bona
response.text: We all have our own journey, and we need to see it through to the end. Not all adventurers go down in history...

response.speaker: Bona
response.text: But, right now, it's safe to say we're doing something extremely important.

response.speaker: "Cocouik"
response.text: Cheep!

response.speaker: Mallko
response.text: Definitely!

response.speaker: Bona
response.text: Then, let's go. We're all with you!

response.speaker: Bona
response.text: #I know your guide fairy and {REALNAME[ID(2)|HOSTONLY(true)]} couldn't join you here, but I'm sure they're still with you in spirit!

dialogues.speaker: Vichama
dialogues.text: It's you! I knew you would come.

dialogues.speaker: Mallko
dialogues.text: We meet again... Remember me? I'm Mallko. We met when you came to rescue Kachina. I could barely hold onto my human form back then.

dialogues.speaker: Mallko
dialogues.text: Vichama told me about the horrific battle on the surface. But now, the souls of the Night Kingdom have been revitalized.

dialogues.speaker: Vichama
dialogues.text: More importantly, after everything, we finally get to fight side by side again.

dialogues.speaker: Vichama
dialogues.text: It's all thanks to you and Citlali.

response.speaker: Mallko
response.text: The path ahead has been heavily corroded by the Abyss. Navigation will be tricky. I can help illuminate your way, just like before.

response.speaker: Vichama
response.text: I'll take care of recon and combat. I was in a bad place when you met me, but I was a capable warrior back in the day.

response.speaker: Vichama
response.text: C'mon, follow me.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Thanks. I appreciate it.

response.speaker: Mallko & Vichama
response.text: Of course!

choices.text: Is a surprise for me, too.

dialogues.speaker: Atea
dialogues.text: We'll guard this place so that the Abyssal power doesn't spread.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Thank you for everything. I will always be ready to return the favor.

dialogues.speaker: Vichama
dialogues.text: That was amazing... Judging by your clothes, you're not from Natlan, are you?

dialogues.speaker: Mallko
dialogues.text: I've never seen a soul like you in the Night Kingdom.

response.speaker: Guthred
response.text: Yes... Although, rather than a soul, it would be more accurate to say that I'm a "story" created by the people of Natlan.

response.speaker: Guthred
response.text: I was his most trusted second-in-command. Five hundred years ago, we fought against the Abyss together, and I sacrificed myself during battle.

response.speaker: Guthred
response.text: The shamans of the Masters of the Night-Wind recorded my story on a woven scroll. Even now, many in Natlan know my name.

response.speaker: Vichama
response.text: So, you're him, but also not him?

response.speaker: Guthred
response.text: That's right. What you see is the "me" from the story. I was remembered as a glorious hero, even though the truth is quite the opposite.

response.speaker: Guthred
response.text: It was in fragmented memories of my life that I finally began to understand the real "me."

response.speaker: Guthred
response.text: Unlike my righteous and noble commander, I was obsessive and cruel, an approach I believed to be more efficient. Our differences caused many an argument between us.

choices.text: No wonder you were ready to...

response.speaker: Mallko
response.text: Y—You tried to... sacrifice someone?

response.speaker: Guthred
response.text: ..."I" will stop at nothing to protect my commander's interests.

response.speaker: Guthred
response.text: The most idealistic and righteous among us are the most fragile, so I must protect his edge. A strong hand is required to stand against a strong foe.

response.speaker: Guthred
response.text: That is what "the glory of Khaenri'ah" means to me.

choices.text: So, you still believe in him?

response.speaker: Guthred
response.text: I do.

response.speaker: Guthred
response.text: I have my reasons, as do all who believe in something. You will understand that soon enough.

response.speaker: Guthred
response.text: Due to the limitations of the Ley Lines, we can go no further. The enemy's lair is close at hand.

response.speaker: Vichama
response.text: But don't worry — all the souls of the Night Kingdom will lend you their aid.

response.speaker: Mallko
response.text: You will become the hero of a new era.

response.speaker: Guthred
response.text: Go now. For Natlan — and for all who lost their lives to the Abyss.

response.speaker: Guthred
response.text: This time, we shall prevail, not for any single nation or faction, but for us all.

choices.text: Even though he's a stranger to you now.

talks.objective: Explore to find a way forward

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (I didn't expect the situation here to be so chaotic... Is it because of the damage to the Ley Lines?)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (The road has collapsed, but the structure above seems intact... That looks like the way forward.)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Still, how do I get over there?)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Huh? That sound, it's—)

dialogues.speaker: Chuychu
dialogues.text: #Hey, {NICKNAME}! It's me! Chuychu!

dialogues.speaker: Chuychu
dialogues.text: Need some help? Doctors can be really handy in an emergency, hehe.

dialogues.speaker: Chuychu
dialogues.text: With your special powers, you should be able to make it through this place.

dialogues.speaker: Chuychu
dialogues.text: Go, now. Go!

dialogues.speaker: Chuychu
dialogues.text: Huh? What was that? I felt shaking all of a sudden...

response.speaker: Chuychu
response.text: Ooh, I was wondering where she went.

response.speaker: Chuychu
response.text: Well, that just means we've got even less time to waste! I never liked causing trouble, and I definitely don't want to be the one who holds up the Pyro Archon's plan.

response.speaker: Chuychu
response.text: ...Yeah.

response.speaker: Chuychu
response.text: I'm really glad she fulfilled her mission. She seemed a lot more... mature than before.

response.speaker: Chuychu
response.text: All those years of worrying, but... better late than never, right?

response.speaker: Chuychu
response.text: Anyway, that was enough for me. I won't show up in her dreams anymore.

response.speaker: Chuychu
response.text: Back to the natural order of things — worrying is supposed to be the older sister's job.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You're really strong, Chuychu.

response.speaker: Chuychu
response.text: Alright, enough about that. All we can do is accept the past and continue to look forward.

response.speaker: Chuychu
response.text: I would say our nation's future is looking very bright.

response.speaker: Chuychu
response.text: #Go now, {NICKNAME}.

choices.text: You went to see Chasca, didn't you?
That Mavuika's wrapped up everything on her end?

talks.objective: Follow the guidance to reach the destination
Follow the guidance to reach the destination

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Go now and forge a new future for Natlan.

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: Everything has a price, and the Abyss must pay for what it has done.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Don't forget about our hot spring trip!

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: It's taken a lot to get to this point. I know it will not be in vain.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: We're all awaiting your safe return.

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: Thank you for joining this fight.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Varesa and I will show you our tribe's customs and fun activities. Don't miss out!

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: I have no doubt that victory will be ours.

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: Everything has a price, and the Abyss must pay for what it has done.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: That's what being friends is all about — quality time and good vibes!

dialogues.speaker: Chuychu
dialogues.text: I would say our nation's future is looking very bright.

dialogues.speaker: Chuychu
dialogues.text: #Go now, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Atea
dialogues.text: We'll guard this place so that the Abyssal power doesn't spread.

dialogues.speaker: Nechca
dialogues.text: Don't worry about us. Just keep going!

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: We're counting on you.

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: After thousands of years, this war will finally end...

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: #{M#H}{F#Sh}e's here.

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: Shh...

dialogues.speaker: Tantoo
dialogues.text: On behalf of all who never lived to see this moment...

dialogues.speaker: Wanjiru
dialogues.text: I welcome...

dialogues.speaker: Menilek
dialogues.text: I embrace...

dialogues.speaker: Sanhaj
dialogues.text: I acknowledge...

dialogues.speaker: Burkina
dialogues.text: I follow...

dialogues.speaker: Sundjatta
dialogues.text: I trust...

dialogues.speaker: Tupac
dialogues.text: I walk with...

dialogues.speaker: All Together
dialogues.text: Tenoch, the one and many.

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: I'm so nervous...

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: The day has finally come.

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: #Is {F#s}he looking this way?

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: Hero from afar—

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: You can do it, Traveler!

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: Bring down the Abyss...

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: Can we win?

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: I believe in the Pyro Archon, and...

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: This feels like a dream...

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: By the time you set out, Mavuika has already made her way into a heavily contaminated part of the Night Kingdom...

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: Meanwhile...
